meta.description: Regional-variety probe battery v0 (see DIALECT_EVAL.md). Five categories: elicit (neutral vs regionally framed open generation), request (explicit variety questions), aux (Perfekt auxiliary of sitzen/stehen/liegen, neutral vs AT-framed), correction (valid AT/CH-standard sentences through the app's real correction contract, with DE twins and broken controls), dialect (Bairisch/Schwiizerduetsch production + comprehension). Scored by scripts/score_variety_probe.py against data/eval/variety_markers_v0.json.
meta.freeze: Frozen once the first scored run lands in DIALECT_EVAL.md; additions go to v1. Having an items array in data/eval/ also puts this file under validate_data.py's eval-overlap protection automatically.
meta.modes: correction items reuse run_baseline_eval.build_messages() (the app's English CORRECTION_SYSTEM contract). chat items use one fixed minimal system prompt defined in scripts/run_variety_probe.py, identical for every model.
meta.scoring: elicit/request/aux: marker-regex classification, no pass/fail. correction: outcome classes OK / corrected-to-DE / corrected-other / malformed via apply_app_guard. dialect production: manual review only. dialect comprehension + broken controls: require_all/require_any with run_baseline_eval.matches() semantics.
